tools.name: gradle
tools.test: if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew test --continue; else gradle test --continue; fi
tools.coverage: d=$(mktemp -d) && printf '%s\n' "allprojects { tasks.matching { it.name == 'jacocoTestReport' }.configureEach { reports { xml.required = true } } }" > "$d/xml.init.gradle" && if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew -I "$d/xml.init.gradle" test jacocoTestReport --continue; else gradle -I "$d/xml.init.gradle" test jacocoTestReport --continue; fi; find . -path '*/build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml' -print0 | xargs -0 cat

tools.name: maven
tools.test: if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw test -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true; else mvn test -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true; fi
tools.coverage: if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw test jacoco:report -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true; else mvn test jacoco:report -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true; fi; find . -path '*/target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml' -print0 | xargs -0 cat
